test_title: PYST 62: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom from the options to replace the underlined segment in the given sentence.

After his business failed, he __had to reduce spending__ and adjust to a frugal lifestyle.

options.text: hit the nail on the head
let the cat out of the bag

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tighten his belt"** means to reduce spending and live more frugally. (अपने खर्चों में कटौती करना)

 
 
• **Example:** With the recent financial crisis, many families have had to **tighten their belts.**
 
 
 
• **"tighten his belt"** is **the most appropriate idiom to replace the underlined segment **in the given sentence. (अपने खर्चों में कटौती करना)
 
 
• **Example:** After his business failed, he had** to tighten his belt** and adjust to a **frugal lifestyle.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer "**tighten his belt**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hit the nail on the head** (सटीक बात करना): To describe exactly what is causing a situation or problem.

 
 
• **Example:** When she said that we need to improve our marketing strategy, she really **hit the nail on the head.**
 
 
 
• **Let the cat out of the bag** (राज़ खोलना): To reveal a secret or a surprise by accident.
 
 
• **Example:** He **let the cat out of the bag** about their surprise party.
 
 
 
• **Kick the bucket** (मर जाना): To die.
 
 
• **Example:** The old man finally **kicked the bucket **after a long illness.
 
 

39:Tb70,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
